Series XIII: Collected Film and Audio Library
Series XIII: Collected Film and Audio Library

This subseries includes audio recordings collected by the Communist Party. The majority of these recordings consist of recorded folk and protest songs, including multiple recordings of the popular socialist song "The Internationale," which was adopted as the anthem of the Socialist International in the late 19th century. Other songs include recordings by notable singers such as Paul Robeson and Pete Seeger. Many recordings feature copies of commercially produced songs, while a select few feature songs performed at events like campaign rallies, youth conferences, or international festivals. Recordings are largely on audio cassette and were created between the 1980s and 1990s, but in some cases these recordings may be reproductions of older songs produced several decades earlier.
